Quick answers from SRE/partner policy side: 
- University spinouts generally qualify for our startup program when they can provide either (A) a university tech transfer letter OR (B) incorporation docs showing the spinout and a faculty advisor listed. A faculty advisory note from Prof. Chen + incorporation paper is usually sufficient.
- For research-only projects (purely academic, no commercial intent), we route to academic/research credits (different SKU). Spinouts with commercial intent go through the startup track.
- Evidence accepted: tech transfer letter, incorporation docs, proof of funding (optional), and a short product one-pager (which Emma already provided).

On the exception: We can approve one-month pilot credits (up to $5k) without a commit via PartnerOps, but anything beyond requires a deal and ops approval. Need Priyomâs sign-off on promo budget.
